field.label: Xray-core Release Channel
field.help: Choose Stable for tested production releases or Latest to include pre-release versions from XTLS/Xray-core.

field.label: GeoData Source Preset
field.help: Select a preconfigured repository for geoip.dat and geosite.dat or choose Custom URLs.

field.label: Custom geoip.dat Direct URL
field.help: Full https:// URL to download geoip.dat (used only when preset is set to Custom).

field.label: Custom geosite.dat Direct URL
field.help: Full https:// URL to download geosite.dat (used only when preset is set to Custom).

field.label: Plugin Branch
field.help: Branch of tribalRu/os-xray-client that "Update Plugin from GitHub" installs. Keep main for normal use; pick another branch only to try changes that have not been merged yet. The list is read from GitHub when this tab opens.

field.label: External Endpoint Lists
field.help: https:// URLs of third-party lists of WARP endpoints, one per line, used by "Find working endpoint" in WireGuard WARP nodes. The list is fetched by the router when a search starts and cached for a day. Accepted formats: JSON [{"ip": "8.6.112.0", "ports": [500, 939]}], JSON with ip:port strings or an ip-to-ports object, or text with ip:port lines. Every entry is still tested end to end, and only Cloudflare addresses are taken unless you allow others in the search options. Leave empty to use the built-in ranges only.
